Starburst
10% of base mana
Instant20 sec cooldown
Applies 1 Scattered Star Per Hit
Smash up to 8 enemies, dealing 2+ArcP*0.3+AP*0.15+0 Arcane damage, scaling with block value and maximum mana and reducing their attack speed by 20% for 10 sec.

Consuming a Scattered Star reduces the remaining cooldown of Starburst by 2 sec.
